entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Taysir's daughter, trapped in the Amber Prison on the Null Moon but able to project her mind to watch Corondor.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A planeswalker, Ravidel's former mentor and Kristina's former lover, who follows the Mox Beacon to Corondor and destroys it.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: A Carthalion leader and planeswalker who defends Corondor, loses his planeswalkerhood and becomes the next Elder Druid.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker, Jared's lover and Justina's mother, who carries the Grey Chime away and loses her spark.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: A raging minotaur obsessed with Kristina, who later helps against Szat and kills Grenfell Mor.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Taysir's maddened former apprentice who wages a war to eliminate planeswalkers and falls into a sinkhole.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A would-be harbinger of the apocalypse who collects the pieces of the Grey Chime.

entities.name: Grenfell Mor
entities.description: A man in Telemar whose mind Szat searches and who goes insane.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who tries to recruit Teferi, steals artifacts, and rings the Grey Chime.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: The time-mage who refuses Leshrac, rescues Taysir, and sets a trap for Ravidel.

entities.name: Caliphear
entities.description: A Nightmare summoned by Teferi who aids Taysir.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who sides with Jared to repay a debt to the Carthalions and faces Szat.

entities.name: Eskil
entities.description: A blind pacifist who defends Shikar and releases Daria from the Amber Prison.

entities.name: Embereck
entities.description: The Ash Warlord, destroyed confronting Ravidel.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: A planeswalker summoned by the Elder Druid, who leads defenders and later protects Jared and Kristina.

entities.name: Elder Druid of Corondor
entities.description: The ruler who sends Jared for a spellbook and summons Dakkon; killed by Ravidel.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: A figure freed from Freyalise's bindings and working for Ravidel.

entities.name: Justina
entities.description: Jared and Kristina's newborn daughter.

entities.name: Grey Chime
entities.description: An artifact of ultimate destruction whose five pieces were kept by the five houses of Corondor.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: A beacon of Moxen (Thran powerstones) that summons planeswalkers to Corondor.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: The plane where planeswalkers assemble for the war.

entities.name: Telemar
entities.description: The Bridge City destroyed by the Grey Chime.

entities.name: Hamath
entities.description: Jared's headquarters, attacked twice by Ravidel.

entities.name: Shikar
entities.description: An eastern Corondor city conquered by Ravidel.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: The prison on the Null Moon holding Daria.

events.summary: Jared and Sandruu duel in Castle Melmereth; Jared escapes with Dihada's spellbook.
events.quote: Still, Jared manages to evade Sandruu long enough to escape with the spellbook.

events.summary: Ravidel conquers Shikar and uses five obsidian stones to hinder other planeswalkers' casting.
events.quote: Next, Daria sees Ravidel conquering the city of Shikar in eastern Corondor.

events.summary: Szat learns of the five houses' Grey Chime pieces and sets out to collect them.
events.quote: Szat heads away from Telemar to collect the five pieces of the chime.

events.summary: Teferi refuses Leshrac's recruitment and sends Caliphear to warn Freyalise.
events.quote: Leshrac then steals some artifacts and spells from the island, ensuring that his visit is not a waste of time.

events.summary: Taysir arrives in Corondor, seeks Kristina, and flees on learning she has another lover.
events.quote: Realizing that Kristina has taken yet another lover, Taysir flees, hurt and confused.

events.summary: Szat defeats Jared and steals the Red Mana Battery.
events.quote: Jared is then assaulted by Tevesh Szat, who quickly defeats him and steals his Red Mana Battery

events.summary: Ravidel tries to recruit Jared for his crusade against planeswalkers and leaves Justina unharmed.
events.quote: Ravidel tries to recruit Jared for his crusade to eliminate all the other planeswalkers

events.summary: Ravidel's first attack on Hamath is repulsed with Freyalise and Dakkon's help.
events.quote: Thus, Ravidel's initial attack on Hamath is repulsed.

events.summary: Ravidel kills the Elder Druid of Corondor.
events.quote: Ravidel himself then turns up and kills the Elder Druid.

events.summary: Embereck is destroyed and Leshrac flees; Taysir confronts Ravidel and is saved by Teferi.
events.quote: The weakened Embereck is destroyed, and Leshrac is forced to flee.

events.summary: Ravidel is horrified that Taysir disapproves of his war and sees it as betrayal.
events.quote: Initially ecstatic to see his mentor again, Ravidel is horrified when Taysir tells him he does not approve of the war orchestrated in his name.

events.summary: Grenfell Mor, insane, hands Szat the final piece of the Chime.
events.quote: Grenfell Mor has gone completely insane at this point and presents Szat with the final part of the Chime.

events.summary: Phyrexian gremlins grab the Mox Beacon and haul it to Phyrexia to destroy it after Taysir opens a door to the Hell of Artifice.
events.quote: Numerous Phyrexian gremlin rush out and grab the Beacon, then haul it over to Phyrexia to destroy it.

events.summary: Sandruu disintegrates Grenfell Mor; Freyalise separates Szat from the Chime and Leshrac decides to activate it.
events.quote: Grenfell nearly kills Kristina with a spell but is then disintegrated by Sandruu.

events.summary: Leshrac rings the Chime as Kristina yanks it away and Telemar goes up in a mushroom cloud.
events.quote: Leshrac rings the chime just as Kristina yanks it from his hands, and Telemar goes up in a mushroom cloud.

events.summary: Teferi's Force of Nature trap and the Chime's chaos make the earth collapse and swallow Ravidel.
events.quote: The earth around Ravidel collapses, and he falls.

events.summary: Kristina is revealed alive but burned and sparkless.
events.quote: Kristina is badly burned from the damage, and her planeswalker spark is now missing.

events.summary: Jared becomes the next Elder Druid, giving up planeswalkerhood.
events.quote: Jared acknowledges his destiny and becomes the next Elder Druid, willingly giving up his planeswalkerhood.

events.summary: Teferi retrieves the Amber Prison and Eskil releases Daria.
events.quote: Teferi retrieves the Amber Prison from the Null Moon and Eskil releases Daria from it.

relations.quote: Taysir nearly falls to his former apprentice but is saved by Teferi.
Daria finds her father somewhere in the space between planes

relations.note: They start a mortal life together with their daughter.
relations.quote: He and Kristina start a mortal life with their daughter in Kristina's Woods
Ravidel turns up in his daughter Justina 's nursery.
He has followed the Mox Beacon to Corondor and immediately sought out his former lover Kristina
Ravidel himself then turns up and kills the Elder Druid.
Grenfell nearly kills Kristina with a spell but is then disintegrated by Sandruu.

relations.note: She sides with Jared to repay a debt.
relations.quote: Freyalise has chosen to side with Jared to repay her debt to the Carthalions of old, Jason and Jauehl .

relations.note: Szat defeated Jared and stole the Battery.
relations.quote: Jared is then assaulted by Tevesh Szat, who quickly defeats him and steals his Red Mana Battery

relations.note: Dakkon becomes protector of Jared's family.
relations.quote: with Dakkon watching over them as their protector.
